The method leverages prior from a Diffusion Model along with complementary multi-modal data (LiDAR depth) to enhance the capacity of 3DGS [S1].

The claim states that the method leverages prior from a Diffusion Model along with complementary multi-modal data (LiDAR depth) to enhance the capacity of 3DGS. The evidence explicitly confirms this in the abstract/introduction section: 'we propose a novel approach that enhances the capacity of 3DGS by leveraging prior from a Diffusion Model along with complementary multi-modal data. This matches every component of the claim.
